messages:
sam: heads up: scheduling a staggered maintenance for az-west-1 - power supply firmware + soft node reboots + nic buffer tuning. Window: Fri Oct 6 01:30-04:30 UTC. Targeting low-traffic window.
nina: can we avoid touching gpu-highmem and dedicated-res pools? they have reserved customers.
sam: yes - excluded by pool label `reserved=true`. we'll only operate on `ephemeral-gpu` and `test-pools`.
chao: last cycle we saw short-lived packet drops during BMC resets. plan to bump egress retries and extend TCP keepalive on sidecars during the window.
sam: noted. plan: BMC reset per-rack, 1 rack at a time, 6-min gap between racks. sidecar keepalive set to 60s for maintenance.
finance: curious re cost: will we need hot spare capacity / cross-region burst? any $ impact estimate?
sam: if we activate cross-region burst to cover load, estimate ~= $2.1k for 3h (data egress + spot uplift). can avoid if routing throttles are tuned.
chao: propose routing throttle for `batch-job` tag to 30% and bump weight to low-latency routes. that should keep tail latency stable without cross-region.
nina: agree. also add a temporary admission controller to reject huge batch in-flight during node handovers.
sam: will push an `admissionLimit` of 500 concurrent for the window.
deploy-bot: calendar event created: "az-west-1 rack BMC + psu fw + nic-tune" Fri Oct 6 01:30 UTC 1: owners: sam, nina.
chao: preflight checks: run `node-health --region az-west-1 --since 1h` and ensure <1% disk errors and <2% gpu-errors. post results here 45m before start.
sam: preflight scheduled at 00:45 UTC. i'll post output.
oncall: i'll be on pager during the window. please add my number to runbook contact.
finance: if we hit cross-region burst, please tag costs to `maintenance:oct-6` so we can reconcile.
sam: ack - cost tags will be added to any temporary clusters.
nina: rollback trigger: if p95 latency > 300ms for 2 consecutive 5m buckets OR errors > 2% for 10m, abort and rejoin nodes back quickly.
chao: putting the automated rollback step into the runbook and adding a manual confirm for reboots after first rack.
sam: runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/az-west-1-psu-bmc-fw.json 1: follow sections "preflight" and "rollback-criteria".
deploy-bot: reminder posted 1h before and 10m before window.
sam: final: shorter batches, rack-by-rack, throttled preseed (if needed), admission limits, routing throttle, and cost tagging. shout if objections. :thumbsup:
